examples.romanization: zhè tiáo jiē zhǐnéng bùxíng tōngguò。
examples.translation: You can only go through this street on foot.

examples.sentence: 我正好经过这儿，顺便过来看看你。
examples.romanization: wǒ zhènghǎo jīngguò zhèr， shùnbiàn guòlái kànkan nǐ。
examples.translation: It just so happened that I’m passing by, [so I] came to see you on the way.

title: 通过 (to pass (an exam, interview or resolution))
shortExplanation: to pass (an exam, interview or resolution)
longExplanation: to pass (an exam, interview or resolution). Pinyin: tōngguò

examples.sentence: 我通过那家公司的面试了。
examples.romanization: wǒ tōngguò nà jiā gōngsī de miànshì le。
examples.translation: I passed the interview with that company.

examples.sentence: 小王把事情的经过告诉我了。
examples.romanization: xiǎo wáng bǎ shìqing de jīngguò gàosu wǒ le。
examples.translation: Xiao Wang told me the whole story of [how] the event [happened].

examples.sentence: 当时她的父母和亲戚都不支持她，可是她坚持自己的选择。
examples.romanization: dāngshí tā de fùmǔ hé qīnqi dōu bù zhīchí tā， kěshì tā jiānchí zìjǐ de xuǎnzé。
examples.translation: At that time her parents and relatives did not support her, but she insisted on her choice.
Please submit the results of the investigation.

examples.sentence: 上学期他学习很用功，结果考试及格了。
examples.romanization: shàng xuéqī tā xuéxí hěn yònggōng， jiéguǒ kǎoshì jígé le。
examples.translation: He studied hard last term and, as a result, he passed the examination.

examples.sentence: 这个城市的地铁已经有上百年的历史了。
examples.romanization: zhège chéngshì de dìtiě yǐjīng yǒu shàng bǎinián de lìshǐ le。
examples.translation: The city's subway has been around for over a hundred years.

examples.sentence: 我本来想当律师，不过后来我发现自己对新闻更感兴趣。
examples.romanization: wǒ běnlái xiǎng dāng lǜshī， bùguò hòulái wǒ fāxiàn zìjǐ duì xīnwén gèng gǎnxìngqù。
examples.translation: I originally wanted to be a lawyer, nevertheless I found myself more interested in news.

examples.sentence: 我们不过谈了点儿工作方面的问题，别的都没谈。
examples.romanization: wǒmen bùguò tán le diǎnr gōngzuò fāngmiàn de wèntí， biéde dōu méi tán。
examples.translation: We only talked about some work problems (and nothing more), and we didn’t talk about anything else.

examples.sentence: 爱情确实是结婚的重要原因，但仅有爱情是不够的。
examples.romanization: àiqíng quèshí shì jiéhūn de zhòngyào yuányīn， dàn jǐn yǒu àiqíng shì bùgòu de。
examples.translation: Love is indeed an important reason for marriage, but only love is not enough.

title: 在 S 看来 (the way S see it)
longExplanation: the way S see it. Pinyin: zài S kànlai

examples.sentence: 在很多人看来，听流行音乐仅仅是年轻人的爱好。
examples.romanization: zài hěn duō rén kànlai， tīng liúxíngyīnyuè jǐnjǐn shì niánqīngrén de àihào。
examples.translation: The way a lot of people sees it [is that] listening to pop music is only a hobby of young people.

examples.sentence: 由于我们的共同努力，任务提前完成了。
examples.romanization: yóuyú wǒmen de gòngtóngnǔlì， rènwu tíqián wánchéng le。
examples.translation: Owing to our joint efforts, the task was fulfilled ahead of schedule.

title: 由于 N (due to N)
longExplanation: due to N. Pinyin: yóuyú N

examples.sentence: 由于种种原因，我们不得不改变原来的计划。
examples.romanization: yóuyú zhǒngzhǒng yuányīn， wǒmen bùdébù gǎibiàn yuánlái de jìhuà。
examples.translation: For various reasons, we had to change the original plan.

examples.sentence: 旅游前最好做个计划，比如要去几个地方，怎么坐车等。
examples.romanization: lǚyóu qián zuìhǎo zuò gè jìhuà， bǐrú yào qù jǐge dìfang， zěnme zuòchē děng。
examples.translation: It is best to make a plan before the trip, for example, how many places to go to, how to take transit, etc.
